rule.fair_value_anchor: point-in-time split-normalized prior official fund NAV and prior official SPY close
rule.upro_residual: (UPRO midpoint / prior UPRO NAV - 1) / 3 - SPY return
rule.spxu_residual: (SPXU midpoint / prior SPXU NAV - 1) / 3 + SPY return
rule.eligibility: positive creation and strictly negative residual
rule.both_qualify: choose the more negative underlying-unit residual
